_comment: Post-extraction corrections. Values here override what Fusion reports, for things Fusion cannot know (datasheet masses for surface-modelled stand-ins) or cannot express (a universal joint in a URDF tree). Keep this file in version control next to the model.
_servo_note: Feetech STS/SCS-class servos are ~55-65 g. The stand-in blocks are surface bodies, so Fusion reports mass 0. Inertia below is a 40x20x35 mm uniform block at 60 g; replace with datasheet values when you have them.

rigid_groups._comment: PROVISIONAL - inferred from world positions, not from CAD. Confirm each, then make them real Rigid Groups in Fusion and delete from here.
rigid_groups.name: inferred_base_servo

split_links._comment: handles_prototype was split in Fusion and exported as two shells. The halves are ONE rigid body -- bonded with a fixed joint at the split. Revolute 18 then drives the U-bridge housing off the far half, making the U-joint a 2-DOF shoulder.

dummy_root._comment: KDL ignores an inertia on the root link, so give it a massless one above base_link.
dummy_root.name: base_footprint
